errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the chart is divided into two separate sections, one for "PHEME" and one for "PolitiFact". It treats all the data as if it belongs to a single chart, which is a fundamental misrepresentation of the figure's structure.

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis lists the categories: “Our”, “W/o select”, “W/o text”, “W/o cognition”, and “W/o emotion”, ordered alphabetically.
errors.evidence: The list of categories is incomplete; it omits “w/o comments”. Furthermore, the categories are not ordered alphabetically on the chart.

errors.text_span: with tick intervals of 5 percentage points
errors.evidence: The y-axis has tick labels and gridlines at intervals of 2.5 percentage points (e.g., 75.0, 77.5, 80.0), not 5.
The bars are not all blue. They are colored with a gradient from dark red and orange on the left to various shades of blue on the right.
The description incorrectly combines two separate categories, "Ours" and "w/o comments", into a single non-existent category.

errors.text_span: the tallest bar, “Our” W/o emotion, reaches a value of 90.57%
errors.evidence: The tallest bar, with a value of 90.57%, corresponds to the category "Ours" in the "PolitiFact" section, not a non-existent category called "Our W/o emotion".

errors.text_span: The bar for “W/o text” has a value of 84.91%
errors.evidence: The value for "w/o text" is 80.10% in the PHEME chart and 83.02% in the PolitiFact chart. The value 84.91% corresponds to the "w/o emotion" bar in the PolitiFact chart.

errors.text_span: with the shortest bar, “W/o select”, having a value of 83.02%
errors.evidence: The shortest bar in the entire figure is for the category "w/o text" in the PHEME chart, with a value of 80.10%. The description incorrectly identifies the label, value, and status as the shortest bar.
